name: Office of Ombudsman for Long-Term Care, Minnesota Board on Aging
organization: Office of Ombudsman for Long-Term Care, Minnesota Board on Aging
description: The regional long-term care ombudsman for this county: advocacy for residents of nursing homes, assisted living and residential care facilities.
next_step: Call the regional ombudsman program. Give the facility name and county. For immediate danger, call 911.
constraints: The ombudsman acts with the resident’s permission and is not a licensing or enforcement agency.
Call 800-657-3591 (toll-free) or 651-431-2555 and give your county and the name of the nursing home or care setting.

The office serves nursing home and boarding care home residents, people in assisted living, customized living and adult foster care, and people receiving home care, including residents of the state veterans homes.
